timestamp_definitions.decision_timestamp: The exact UTC timestamp representing the close of the completed 15-minute decision bar (e.g. 12:15:00 UTC).
timestamp_definitions.feature_cutoff_timestamp: Strictly equal to decision_timestamp. No data with available_timestamp > decision_timestamp may enter any feature computation.
timestamp_definitions.fill_timestamp: decision_timestamp + 60 seconds (the open of the immediate subsequent 1-minute execution bar).

point_in_time_invariants.no_same_bar_hindsight: 15-minute decision bar high/low/close are available ONLY after the 15-minute bar is fully closed.
